source.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science

rows.source_position_paraphrase: Tool access empowers scientists and mathematicians.
rows.response_heading: Access is useful. It is not freedom

rows.source_position_paraphrase: The announced 100,000-researcher programme establishes broad access.
rows.response_heading: Access is useful. It is not freedom
rows.response_evidence_phrase: One hundred thousand accounts is a large offer

rows.source_position_paraphrase: Evaluation on open problems supports research-contributor status.
rows.response_heading: Open problems belong to the human commons
rows.response_evidence_phrase: open problems are part of the human commons

rows.source_position_paraphrase: Later research supports the value and attribution of an earlier model-produced result.
rows.response_heading: Open problems belong to the human commons
rows.response_evidence_phrase: Later papers can show that an idea was useful

rows.source_position_paraphrase: The selected main results had seen no progress for at least a decade.
rows.response_heading: Open problems belong to the human commons
rows.response_evidence_phrase: Calling a problem stagnant for a decade

rows.source_position_paraphrase: The selected problems are substantially important to their fields.
rows.response_heading: Open problems belong to the human commons

rows.source_position_paraphrase: The internal Astra model achieved the results.
rows.response_heading: A model is part of a causal chain, not a magician

rows.source_position_paraphrase: Roughly two thousand dollars at API token rates represents the solution cost.
rows.response_heading: A model is part of a causal chain, not a magician
rows.response_evidence_phrase: Two thousand dollars is a serving-price estimate

rows.source_position_paraphrase: Humans prepared manuscripts after the model generated the arguments.
rows.response_heading: Preparing a paper is thinking
rows.response_evidence_phrase: Preparing a manuscript is not typing up

rows.source_position_paraphrase: The model formalized each argument in Lean.
rows.response_heading: Preparing a paper is thinking
rows.response_evidence_phrase: Lean can verify that a proof follows

rows.source_position_paraphrase: Released model narrations explain the discovery process.
rows.response_heading: Preparing a paper is thinking
rows.response_evidence_phrase: A polished narration is not a causal record

rows.source_position_paraphrase: A technology company cannot decide AI's mathematical role alone.
rows.response_heading: A community cannot be invited after the credit has been allocated
rows.response_evidence_phrase: OpenAI is right that one company cannot settle

rows.source_position_paraphrase: Human authorship misrepresents a proof attributed entirely to AI.
rows.response_heading: Human authorship is not a lie

rows.source_position_paraphrase: OpenAI can take correctness responsibility while assigning argument generation to the system.
rows.response_heading: Human authorship is not a lie
rows.response_evidence_phrase: Responsibility and authorship cannot be cleanly pulled apart

rows.source_position_paraphrase: The community should contextualise and build on the results.
rows.response_heading: A community cannot be invited after the credit has been allocated

rows.source_position_paraphrase: Widespread access is the fundamental response as AI becomes a collaborator.
rows.response_heading: Access is useful. It is not freedom
rows.response_evidence_phrase: Access without provenance, portability and rights can become dependency
